minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, June 16, 2021
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, June 16, 2021.
  Members present: Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, George Borst, Jenny Jolly, Lorraine
  Missick and Scott Snider.
  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Manager and Amanda Triay,
  Community Services Specialist.
  Guests present: None.
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, May 19,
  2021 meeting, motion carried.

  Unfinished Business
2. Senior Nutrition Program: An average of 114 meals served per week to curbside
  recipients in May 2021. Curbside meal service will continue until County approves
  congregated meals.

3. Guest Speaker: None.

4. Bingo Report: In person Bingo will resume the second week in July. Doors will open
  at 11:30AM and Bingo will end at 3:30 PM. Masks will not be required for fully
  vaccinated participants and no social distancing will be required. There will be an
  announcement in the July Newsletter and on social media. Cost will remain the
  same and Bingo West is still available.

5. Meals on Wheels: 720 meals provided to 40 La Verne residents.

6. Account Balance: $3,276.73

7. Senior Program Fees: The Garden Group will return in July and special needs may
  return sooner.

8. Mt. SAC Classes: All virtual classes until fall.

9. Aging Next: Stacy Middlestep reported 174 meals were served in La Verne and 14
  La Verne residents were helped.
   New Business

10. Upcoming Events:
  Monday, June 21st – American Red Cross Blood Drive, 10:00 AM
  Saturday, July 3rd – July 4th Parade, 10:00 AM
  Sunday, July 4th – Fireworks Show at Bonita High School
  August – 2 concerts in the park and 1 movie.

11. Facilities Report: The Community Center will open July 12th. Veterans Hall is open
  for preschool. All the exit signs were replaced at the Community Center.

12. Public Comments: George gave an update on Senior Golf. There are 10-22 people
  participating and are on schedule to play the 2nd and 4th Tuesday of the month.

  Scott: There are no public events at Hillcrest. Yvonne’s office will move to City Hall
  soon. There will be a Coordinator position opening up. Amanda is setting up
  excursions and suggested the Laguna Arts Festival. Registration will tentatively start
  July 12th.

13. Adjourn: A motion was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting, motion
  approved and carried. The meeting was adjourned at 10:50 AM. Next meeting will
  be held at the Community Center on August 18, 2021 at 10:00 AM.
